findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/cli-argument-ergonomics-smoke.ts:64 - The new CHK-001 smoke is not hermetic. It spawns `koala checklist_update` in the current repo/worktree, so when it is rerun from the normal story worktree REVIEW context it hits the active-story phase gate before schema validation and fails with `命令 "checklist_update" 在 REVIEW 阶段不可用` instead of the expected validation error. I reproduced this with `node packages/main/dist/tasks/cli-argument-ergonomics-smoke.js` from .worktrees/B-4a05. This makes the recorded verification command non-reproducible during review/test and weakens regression coverage. Fix: run the spawned CLI in an isolated temp repo/cwd or set `cwd`/`KOALA_PROJECT_ROOT` explicitly so the smoke always exercises validation rather than the active-story gate.
